suite.name: miniwob-multi-tool-smoke
suite.limitation: This is a curated integration harness, not a full autonomous agent or representative BrowserGym benchmark. In multi-tool mode, it extracts only explicit values from synthetic task instructions, selects exact visible options, and sets explicit keyboard-slider targets. When enabled, synthetic approval is limited to an explicitly requested action on the exact local file:// task page. The optional visual OCR path tries only an explicitly quoted link label.
